WITH line_status AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        CASE WHEN rtrim(lower(o.status)) = 'returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_returned
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'order_items') }} i
    JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }} o
        ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'products') }} p
        ON p.product_id = i.product_id
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) AS line_count,
    CAST(SUM(is_returned) AS INTEGER) AS returned_lines,
    CAST(SUM(is_returned) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS return_rate
FROM line_status
GROUP BY product_id, product_name

explanation: This procedure builds a per-product summary of order lines: for each product it counts how many order lines include it, how many of those lines have a status of "returned", and the share of lines returned. The return rate is stored as a floating-point number. The rebuilt model matches SQL Server's case- and trailing-space-insensitive status comparison, so variants like "Returned" or "RETURNED " still count as returns.
